Definition: description
A provider-assigned accession identifier for a given entity.
The priority or display order of an entity among all other entities of the same type.
Unique identifier for each individual cell.
Human-readable cluster label for the cluster assigned to this cell at a given annotation level.
Notes: String value; one per annotation level column; for object modeling derive via Cell.part_of_cluster → Cluster.annotated_as

Definition: Identifier for the sequencing library from which molecular measurements were derived.
Notes: it should be pointing to BarcodedCellSample, and the slot name should also change; nhash id should be used

Definition: Human-readable sequencing modality (e.g. 10x 3' v3).
EFO ontology term for assay (e.g. EFO:0009922 for 10x 3' v3).
Human-readable name for the anatomical region from which the cell was collected.
UBERON ontology term for anatomical region (e.g. UBERON:0000955 for brain).
Brain atlas region ID from DHBA/HBA/MBA for the anatomical region.
Whether the measurement was performed on intact cells, nuclei, or is not applicable.
True if this is the canonical instance of this cellular observation; False for reanalysis or secondary views.
Unique identifier for this annotation level.
Name of this annotation level used as column header in obs (e.g. Class, Subclass).
Integer rank of this annotation level in the hierarchy; lower values are broader types.
A tag denoting whether this grouping represents a taxonomic level or neighborhood.
Unique identifier for this cell type taxon.
Human-readable label for this cell type taxon at the given annotation level (e.g. Glutamatergic).
Stable cross-version identifier for this cell type taxon (e.g. CS20230722_CLAS_11).
The priority or display order of this taxon among all taxons in the taxonomy.
CL ontology term for this cell type; use CL:0000003 for native cell if unknown.
Notes: Scientifically a property of the cell type not the individual cell (Jeremy); stored per-cell in obs in AIT h5ad; README uses cell_type_ontology_term_id; AIT csv uses cell_type_ontology_term

Definition: The aggregated number of cells that defines this cell type taxon.
Unique identifier for this taxonomy.
Description differentiating this taxonomy from others in the same collection; should be unique within a collection.
Provider-assigned accession identifier for this taxonomy (e.g. CCN20230722).
Version of the AIT schema used to produce this file (e.g. 1.0.0).
Permanent URL to molecular data if the expression matrix is not embedded in the file.
Notes: Moved to ExpressionMatrix.content_url; retained here for reference until model is finalized

Definition: Cell metadata key(s) in obs that define batches for normalization or integration.
Notes: Multivalued list of obs column names; no BKE equivalent

Definition: JSON-formatted hierarchical clustering dendrogram encoding the taxonomy hierarchy.
Notes: Stored as JSON; BKE encodes same structure via CellTypeTaxon.has_parent; retained for tooling

Definition: Ordered mapping of annotation level names to integer ranks; lower rank means broader type.
Notes: Stored as dict; overlaps with CellTypeSet.order; retained for tooling convenience

Definition: Active taxonomy mode controlling which subset of cells and analysis components to use.
Notes: Computed for analysis; Jeremy: folks can ignore

Definition: Per-mode boolean flags indicating cells to exclude (True means exclude).
Notes: Multivalued; computed for analysis; Jeremy: folks can ignore

Definition: Full description of clustering algorithm and parameters used to produce cluster assignments.
Summary table of cluster-level metadata including cluster sizes and representative metadata.
Notes: Stored as dict; Jeremy: effectively the obs table saved per cluster; what people call the "Google Sheet" of cell type annotations

Definition: Key in obsm of the embedding to display by default; must match an X_-prefixed entry.
Notes: String key matching Embedding.embedding_key of the default embedding to display

Definition: CAS annotation schema stored as JSON encoding labelset and annotation metadata.
Notes: Jeremy: placeholder; currently redundant with cluster_info; no BKE equivalent

Definition: Marker gene expression data for patchseq quality control analysis.
Notes: Computed; should never be manually entered; AIT csv has typo (qualty_control_markers); no BKE equivalent

Definition: Unique identifier for this embedding.
Key used to store the embedding in obsm; must be prefixed with X_ (e.g. X_umap, X_pca).
N-dimensional matrix of shape n_cells × n_dims representing the low-dimensional projection.
Unique identifier for this expression matrix.
Whether this matrix contains normalized expression values or raw counts.
URL to the matrix file if the matrix is not embedded directly in the h5ad file.
Notes: Corresponds to AIT dataset_purl; BKE ExpressionMatrix.content_url

Definition: Unique identifier for this cluster set.
Human-readable name for this cluster set (e.g. the name of the clustering run).
Unique identifier for this cluster.
Human-readable label for this cluster; corresponds to cluster_id values in obs.
Number of cells assigned to this cluster.
